run_channel_connectivity_tests: run the gRPC channel connectivity unit tests with unittest to verify channel state transitions
test_lonely_channel_connectivity: test channel connectivity on an unreachable localhost:12345 to confirm IDLE state without READY
test_immediately_connectable_channel_con: test channel connectivity with a live gRPC server to verify IDLE then READY transitions
test_reachable_then_unreachable_channel_: test channel connectivity by starting then stopping a server to verify READY to non-READY transition
review_Callback_class: review the _Callback class that uses threading.Condition to track and block on gRPC channel connectivity states
